name: PR list findings counters open a per-severity modal without navigating
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click PR #482's CRITICAL counter and confirm the per-severity modal opens over the list. This is the one flow that covers a row-level overlay: the whole row navigates on click, so the counter must open the modal INSTEAD of routing to /pulls/482 — a regression there is invisible to unit tests of either piece alone. Staying on the list is asserted via 'Sort: Newest' (a list-only control) remaining visible while the modal is up, and by the row still being there after closing. Seeded PR #482 carries 1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING finding (server/src/db/seed.ts), so SUGGESTION is a zero counter — inert, not a button, which is why only Critical/Warning are clicked here. Read-only seeded data (no model call).
